Counselling

A private space to be understood.

Confidential one-to-one, family and couples counselling at BSS Skill School & Counseling Centre, Kondotty — or online, wherever you are.

Personal Counselling

Strictly confidential one-to-one sessions for stress, persistent anxiety, self-doubt, emotional difficulty and personal goal paralysis.

Book this session

Adolescent & Family Counselling

Collaborative sessions with parents and teenagers addressing behavioural friction, excessive screen use, academic refusal and conflict at home.

Book this session

Couples & Pre-marital Counselling

Structured preparation for engaged couples to align values and expectations, alongside guidance for marital strain.

Book this session

Career Guidance

Helping students and parents find genuine career alignment, choose streams and courses, and plan for entrance examinations.

Book this session

Learning Difficulty & Study Support

Assessment-led guidance for students struggling academically, with practical roadmaps for parents, tutors and teachers.

Book this session

Meditation & Relaxation Therapy

Breathing protocols, progressive muscle relaxation and mindfulness techniques for exam panic, chronic anxiety and sleeplessness.

Book this session
Who It Is For

If something feels heavier than it should, it is worth a conversation.

Parents

Concerned about a child's academic performance, behavioural resistance, device addiction, or growing emotional distance at home.

Students

At a crossroads — choosing streams or degrees, preparing for entrance tests, or struggling with exam anxiety.

Couples

Preparing for marriage, or working through strain, communication gaps and changing expectations.

Individuals

Living with stress, anxiety, low confidence or burnout, and ready to understand what is driving it.

The Process

From first message to first session

Choose your consultation

Select the type of session, in-person or online, and a preferred slot on the booking page.

Complete the registration

Share a few details about who the session is for and what you would like help with.

Reserve with a ₹500 advance

Pay the advance by UPI and submit your transaction reference. It is adjusted against your final fee.

Confirmation & first session

Once the payment is verified, the office confirms your appointment. The first session is unhurried and focused on listening.

Consultation Information

Good to know before you book

  • Hours: Monday – Saturday, 9:30 AM – 6:30 PM, by prior appointment
  • In person: BSS Skill School & Counseling Centre, Tower 17, EC Mall, ICA Campus, Kondotty
  • Online: Video consultations for clients across India and the GCC
  • Languages: Malayalam, English, Arabic and Hindi
  • Confidentiality: Strict ethical confidentiality in every individual and family session
